description: Skelet AF-05f-i stale-run reaper: operator sweep failing crashed and over-budget kit runs with quota release

compatibility.instructions: Does adding server-only reapStaleKitRuns plus 4 tests change the frozen Build Kit contract, the kit lifecycle matrix, the revision/lease protocol, or any tenant-facing envelope? The reaper only drives legal active-to-failed transitions through the existing revision-guarded update plus the existing releaseQuota; no new status, no matrix change, no REST/MCP surface. Do existing callers keep working?

correctness.instructions: Is the reaper factually correct: candidates are active non-queued unpurged runs ordered oldest-first and locked SKIP LOCKED; lease-stale means absent or expired lease; over-budget means started_at plus scope timeBudgetMs elapsed; timeout wins when both fire; per-run transition clears lease, stamps finished_at, classifies worker-lost/timeout, releases quota, preserves identities and history; live/queued/terminal/purged rows untouched; limit 1..100; invalid now/limit fail closed?

evidence.instructions: Are the 4 tests sufficient: expired-lease reap with quota-release proof (cap wedged then freed), pure-timeout reap with live lease, live/queued/terminal untouched with scanned count, bounded ordered cross-tenant sweep with invalid-input rejection and idempotent re-reap? Full db suite 27/27 green with typecheck/lint clean?

reliability.instructions: Any nondeterminism: oldest-first order with kit_id tiebreak, SKIP LOCKED convergence for duplicate sweeps, revision guard against mid-sweep worker advances, deterministic error precedence, bounded limit? Any path that double-releases quota or resurrects terminal runs?

scope.instructions: Anything beyond the reaper slice: new capture, traversal, billing, REST/MCP/UI surface, paid services, or unrelated refactors? Is the change limited to one store function plus its tests and review evidence?

security.instructions: Does the cross-workspace operator scan leak tenant data: no tenant-facing surface added, returned records are opaque operator identifiers consumed by server logs only, per-run updates stay workspace-scoped with revision guards, error classes match the safe taxonomy, no secrets or remote code?
